name: Proxmox
description: Your Proxmox VE in Swarm: the cluster's nodes, VMs and containers with their graphs; start, shut down, reboot and snapshot them; tasks and their logs; and agents that do the same with swarm proxmox.

settings.title: Proxmox address
settings.description: The address you open Proxmox at. Proxmox's page of Settings sets it.

settings.title: API token ID
settings.description: USER@REALM!NAME. Proxmox's page of Settings sets it.

settings.title: API token secret
settings.description: Proxmox's page of Settings sets it.

settings.title: Trusted certificate
settings.description: The fingerprint of Proxmox's own certificate, trusted in place of a certificate authority's. Proxmox's page of Settings sets it.
